The '''Credit coffer''' was a kind of vault used by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] on [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|Cybloc Transfer Station]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==History==
When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother/apprentice [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|attacked]] the station, and destroyed the [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|droids]] guarding it, Savage found a coffer full of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Later it was offered to [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]] and several other [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], in return for joining the brothers against [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]].
